originalTitle: Why This Leveraged S&P 500 ETF Can Lose Money Even When Stocks Rise
summary: Leveraged ETFs promise amplified gains, but SPXL hides a counterintuitive flaw that can turn a rising market into a losing trade. Understanding what actually happens inside this fund each day changes everything about how you should use it.
content:
The S&P 500 is up approximately 10% in 2026, on track for another year of strong performance, prompting many investors to look for ways to amplify their returns. One increasingly popular option is the Direxion Daily S&P 500 Bull 3X Shares ( NYSEARCA:SPXL ), a leveraged ETF designed to deliver three times the daily performance of the S&P 500.

At first glance, the strategy appears straightforward. Simply put, if the index rises, SPXL should rise even more. However, leveraged ETFs are far more complex than many investors realize. Because SPXL resets its leverage daily, its long-term performance can differ significantly from three times the S&P 500’s return. In some cases, investors can even lose money over a period when the index itself finishes higher.

Before purchasing SPXL, investors should understand how daily leverage, compounding, and market volatility can influence returns, and why this fund is generally intended for short-term tactical trading rather than long-term investing.

Why Leveraged ETFs Don’t Always Deliver Multi-X Long-Term Returns

One major misconception about leveraged ETFs is that they simply multiply an index’s long-term performance. In reality, funds like SPXL are designed to deliver three times the S&P 500’s daily return, not its return over weeks, months, or years.

Because the fund resets its leverage at the end of each trading day, returns compound over time, causing performance to depend not only on where the market ends up, but also on the path it takes to get there.

This effect becomes more noticeable during times of volatility or long periods of sideways chop.

Large swings in either direction can gradually erode returns through what’s commonly known as volatility drag. This means that SPXL may significantly underperform three times the S&P 500’s cumulative gain, or in a worst-case scenario even lose money during periods when the index finishes higher.

The Direxion Daily S&P 500 Bull 3X Shares (SPXL) seeks to deliver 300% of the daily performance of the S&P 500 Index.

Rather than purchasing three dollars’ worth of stocks for every dollar invested, the fund uses derivatives to achieve the desired goal. This includes purchasing swaps, futures, and other financial instruments to obtain leveraged exposure. This exposure is reset at the close of each trading day.

This daily rebalancing allows SPXL to closely track its stated objective over a single trading session, making it particularly popular among active traders looking to capitalize on short-term market moves. However, the same mechanism that creates amplified gains for a single trading day is also what can cause longer-term returns to diverge from a simple three-times multiple of the index.

Despite its inherent risks, SPXL can be an effective tool under the right market conditions.

The fund has historically performed best during strong, sustained bull markets where the S&P 500 advances steadily with relatively low day-to-day volatility. In these environments, positive daily compounding can even work in investors’ favor, allowing returns to exceed what many might expect from simply multiplying the index’s cumulative gain. For example, five- year cumulative returns of 154.93% far exceed those of the S&P 500 over the same period. However, during this period, there were moments when SPXL also significantly underperformed. For that reason, SPXL is generally best suited for short-term tactical trades or for experienced investors with a high conviction that the market’s upward momentum will continue.

Who Should (and Shouldn’t) Own SPXL

Because the fund provides three times the S&P 500’s daily return, it can be an effective tactical tool for investors with a high-conviction bullish outlook and who are actively monitoring their positions. However, leveraged ETFs require disciplined risk management, as losses are magnified just as quickly as gains.

Despite strong performance, SPXL is generally not an appropriate choice for long-term buy-and-hold investors. Investors seeking broad exposure to the S&P 500 will likely be better served buying traditional index ETFs, which are designed to track the market’s long-term performance without the added complexity of daily leverage resets and compounding effects. Likewise, with an expense ratio of 0.84%, traditional index funds like the SPDR S&P 500 ETF ( NYSEARCA:SPY ) offer a much more affordable ways to gain broad market exposure.

SPXL can be a powerful investment vehicle when used as intended. That said, it is not simply a way to earn 3X the S&P 500’s long-term return. Its daily leverage reset means market volatility and the sequence of returns can have a meaningful impact on performance over time.

Investors who understand these mechanics and use SPXL as a short-term tactical tool may benefit from its amplified exposure, while long-term investors are generally better served buying traditional, more cost-effective unleveraged index funds.

chineseTitle: 为什么这只杠杆标普 500 ETF 即使在股市上涨时也会亏损
chineseSummary: 杠杆 ETF 承诺放大收益，但 SPXL 隐藏了一个违反直觉的缺陷，可能会将上涨的市场变成亏损的交易。了解该基金每天实际发生的情况会改变您如何使用它的一切。
chineseContent:
标准普尔 500 指数到 2026 年将上涨约 10%，有望再创强劲表现，促使许多投资者寻找扩大回报的方法。一个越来越受欢迎的选择是 Direxion Daily S&P 500 Bull 3X Shares ( NYSEARCA:SPXL )，这是一种杠杆 ETF，旨在实现 S&P 500 每日表现的三倍。

乍一看，该策略似乎很简单。简而言之，如果该指数上涨，SPXL 应该会上涨得更多。然而，杠杆 ETF 远比许多投资者意识到的复杂。由于 SPXL 每天都会重置其杠杆，因此其长期表现可能与标准普尔 500 指数回报率的三倍有很大差异。在某些情况下，当指数本身收高时，投资者甚至可能会在一段时间内亏损。

在购买 SPXL 之前，投资者应了解每日杠杆、复利和市场波动如何影响回报，以及为什么该基金通常用于短期战术交易而不是长期投资。

为什么杠杆 ETF 并不总是能带来多重长期回报

关于杠杆 ETF 的一个主要误解是，它们只是简单地乘以指数的长期表现。事实上，像 SPXL 这样的基金旨在提供标准普尔 500 指数每日回报的三倍，而不是几周、几个月或几年的回报。

由于该基金在每个交易日结束时都会重置其杠杆，因此回报会随着时间的推移而复合，导致业绩不仅取决于市场最终的走向，还取决于市场最终走向的路径。

在波动时期或长时间横盘震荡期间，这种效应变得更加明显。

任一方向的大幅波动都会通过所谓的波动性拖累逐渐侵蚀回报。这意味着 SPXL 的表现可能明显低于标准普尔 500 指数累计涨幅的三倍，或者在最坏的情况下，甚至在指数收高期间亏损。

Direxion 每日 S&P 500 Bull 3X 股票 (SPXL) 力求提供 S&P 500 指数每日表现的 300%。

该基金不是每投资一美元就购买价值三美元的股票，而是利用衍生品来实现预期目标。这包括购买掉期、期货和其他金融工具以获得杠杆敞口。该风险敞口在每个交易日结束时重置。

这种每日重新平衡使 SPXL 能够在单个交易时段密切跟踪其既定目标，使其在寻求利用短期市场波动的活跃交易者中特别受欢迎。然而，在单个交易日创造放大收益的同一机制也可能导致长期回报偏离指数的简单三倍。

尽管存在固有风险，但在适当的市场条件下，SPXL 可以成为一种有效的工具。

从历史上看，该基金在强劲、持续的牛市期间表现最佳，其中标准普尔 500 指数稳步上涨，日常波动性相对较低。在这些环境下，正的每日复利甚至可以对投资者有利，使回报超出许多人通过简单地乘以指数累积收益而预期的回报。例如，五年累计回报率为154.93%，远超同期标普500指数。然而，在此期间，SPXL 也有表现明显不佳的时候。因此，SPXL 通常最适合短期战术交易或坚信市场上涨势头将持续的经验丰富的投资者。

谁应该（也不应该）拥有 SPXL

由于该基金提供的每日回报是标准普尔 500 指数的三倍，因此对于坚定看涨前景并积极监控其仓位的投资者来说，它可以成为一种有效的战术工具。然而，杠杆ETF需要严格的风险管理，因为损失和收益一样会迅速放大。

尽管表现强劲，但 SPXL 通常不是长期买入并持有投资者的合适选择。寻求广泛投资标普 500 指数的投资者可能会更适合购买传统指数 ETF，这些 ETF 旨在跟踪市场的长期表现，而不会增加每日杠杆重置和复合效应的复杂性。同样，SPDR S&P 500 ETF (NYSEARCA:SPY) 等传统指数基金的费用率为 0.84%，提供了一种更实惠的方式来获得广泛的市场敞口。

如果按预期使用，SPXL 可以成为一种强大的投资工具。也就是说，这不仅仅是赚取标准普尔 500 指数 3 倍长期回报的一种方式。其每日杠杆重置意味着市场波动和回报顺序可能会随着时间的推移对业绩产生有意义的影响。

了解这些机制并使用 SPXL 作为短期战术工具的投资者可能会从其扩大的风险敞口中受益，而长期投资者通常更适合购买传统的、更具成本效益的非杠杆指数基金。
